existing_to_reuse: Append-only audit ledger (hash-chained event log) — reuse for proof-carrying actions, tribunal verdicts, and legal hold records
Policy engine / rule evaluator — reuse as the owner-override and promotion-gate decision point (wrap, don't rewrite)
Scheduler + job queue — reuse to drive champion/challenger, calibration, and regression runs
Metrics/telemetry pipeline (OTel-style traces + spans) — reuse for observability of all P07 flows
Secrets/config vault — reuse for model credentials and DeepSeek temporary keys
Existing eval harness / golden-set runner — wrap as the verifier substrate for dynamic verifier generation
Existing database with row-level audit columns — reuse for records, disputes, and closure state
Notification/alerting channel (Slack/webhook) — reuse for human-required escalations and gate failures
Existing API gateway + authz layer — reuse for M2M negotiation authentication and scoping
Feature-flag / kill-switch service — reuse for rollback and preprod-only enforcement
gaps: No canonical evidence schema binding task→proof→verdict (blocks NO_EVIDENCE→NOT_DONE and proof-carrying actions)
No formal model of the multi-agent tribunal (actor/verifier/adversary roles, quorum, appeal)
No calibration store linking forecasts to realized outcomes with Brier/log scoring
No collusion detector over inter-agent message graphs
No promotion gate contract (staging→preprod→promoted) with automated blocking criteria
No delete-candidate gate with provenance + downstream-reference checks
No self-repair swarm supervisor with bounded retry and blast-radius limits
No machine-readable task contract schema (acceptance tests, evidence, rollback)
No regression baseline registry for model behavior drift
No discovery-council intake pipeline (candidate techno/technique → triage → absorb)
No closure engine unifying done-ness across all P07 sub-flows
contracts: EvidenceRecord{v1}: {id, task_id, kind, artifact_uri, hash, produced_by, ts, verifier_sig}
TaskContract{v1}: {id, goal, acceptance_tests[], evidence_required[], rollback_plan, owner, preprod_only:true}
Verdict{v1}: {task_id, actor, verifier, adversary, decision(PASS|FAIL|APPEAL), rationale, evidence_refs[], ts}
CalibrationSample{v1}: {forecast_id, p, outcome, brier, horizon, model_version}
Dispute{v1}: {id, claimant, claim, evidence_refs, state, resolution, legal_hold:bool}
NegotiationMsg{v1}: {session_id, from, to, offer, constraints, sig}
OwnerOverride{v1}: {actor, reason, scope, expiry, approved_by, audit_ref}
DeleteCandidate{v1}: {artifact_id, justification, downstream_refs[], decision, approver, ts}

implementation_batches.scope: Contracts + evidence ledger schema; TaskContract, EvidenceRecord, Verdict, ClosureRecord
implementation_batches.exit: schemas validated; ledger append works; NO_EVIDENCE→NOT_DONE enforced in preprod

implementation_batches.scope: Tribunal core: actor/verifier/adversary + tribunal state machine + owner-override wrapper
implementation_batches.exit: tribunal runs end-to-end with quorum and appeal path

implementation_batches.scope: Calibration + regression: forecast store, scoring, model-behavior baseline registry
implementation_batches.exit: calibration samples scored; regression drift alerts fire

implementation_batches.scope: Gates: promotion gate + delete-candidate gate + bias/confounder checks
implementation_batches.exit: gates block on missing evidence; promote/delete only in preprod

implementation_batches.scope: Collusion monitor + M2M negotiation contracts + proof-carrying action wrapper
implementation_batches.exit: graph detector flags synthetic collusion; neg msgs signed
dispute lifecycle + hold flag enforced; closures require evidence_refs

implementation_batches.scope: Discovery council + tech absorption + self-repair swarm + dynamic verifier generator
implementation_batches.exit: intake→triage→absorb path; verifier generated and registered

implementation_batches.scope: Evaluation control plane UI/API + observability wiring + rollback drill
implementation_batches.exit: single pane for P07; kill-switch exercised

tests: NO_EVIDENCE→NOT_DONE: task without EvidenceRecord cannot close
Proof-carrying action: action without proof artifact rejected by gate
Tribunal quorum: verdict requires actor+verifier+adversary signatures
Calibration scoring: brier/log-loss matches reference on fixture set
Regression: injected behavior drift triggers alert
Promotion gate: fails on missing evidence or failed regression
Delete gate: fails when downstream_refs non-empty
Collusion: synthetic colluding agent pair detected
M2M negotiation: tampered offer rejected on sig mismatch
Dispute lifecycle: open→resolve with legal_hold honored
security: Enforce PREPROD_ONLY at network + policy layer; deny prod writes
Hash-chain ledger for tamper-evident proofs and verdicts
Signed M2M negotiation messages; replay protection
DeepSeek temporary credentials: short TTL, no persistence of prompts beyond eval window
Legal-hold flag blocks deletion at DB layer, not just app
observability: Span every tribunal, gate, calibration, and closure flow
Emit metrics: gate_pass/fail, calibration_brier, regression_drift, collusion_score, closure_rate
Structured logs with task_id + evidence_id correlation
Alert on gate failure spikes and owner-override usage
rollback: Kill-switch per gate and per swarm component
Feature-flag all new P07 flows; default-off outside preprod
Ledger appends immutable — rollback via superseding records, never deletes
Promotion/delete actions reversible via prior snapshot reference
Rollback drill in B8 before any staging sign-off
distillation_targets: Reusable P07 judgment rubric (evaluator playbook) from tribunal outcomes
Calibration model distilled into lightweight scorer
Verifier generator patterns → reusable verifier library
Gate policy set → baseline policy bundle for future programs
Dispute resolution precedents → claims knowledge base
